svg.title: Christopher Woodyard · Vers3Dynamics
svg.desc: Christopher Woodyard. Vers3Dynamics, an independent open-source laboratory. I make strange things and test whether they work. The Adinkra symbol Nea Onnim No Sua A, Ohu: one who does not know can know from learning. Three specimen drawers depict research, signals and decisions; one is open for the next experiment.
